title: Longest word
prompt: longest_word(words) returns the longest word (the first one on a tie), or "" if there are no words. It returns the wrong word, and crashes on an empty list.
hints: Which variable holds the answer, and which one is returned?
After the loop, 'word' still holds the last item it saw. If the loop never ran, 'word' was never created at all.
explanation: The function returned the loop variable 'word', which still held the last item after the loop and did not exist at all for an empty list. It should return 'longest'.
